entities.name: Akaki Chachua
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akaki Chachua is a Georgian wrestler who competed in the Men's Greco-Roman 64 kg at the 2000 Summer Olympics and won the bronze medal. He also competed in the 2004 Summer Olympics and finished 9th.
